clauses.text: Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 90 days before the end of the calendar year.
Delivery FCA; standard lead time 56 days from order.
The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.
Valid from 2025-07-01 to 2027-06-30; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 90 days' notice.

persona.summary: Czech family foundry (150 staff, EUR 8.3 M), we are 2.4 % of its turnover and growing 30 %. It calls Hollerau an important reference customer and opened a new moulding line (Apr 2026), which may mean spare capacity. Holds only 25 % of Volute casing HI 80-250; 70180 has 75 % (at a higher 654.52). Historically gives way fully (kept share below 0). Quality slipping: ppm 5682, red Q3. Push hard with volume as the carrot.
persona.notes: New moulding line may mean spare capacity; it values Hollerau as a reference. Fears losing the 25 % share to 70180. Only a generic 10-day payment e-mail; we pay 5.5 days late on average. No should-cost for its part.

levers: binding volume for the new moulding line
arguments: volume shift from co-source 70180 (70180 is dearer, no rival-price argument)
quality record: ppm 5682 and red Q3, OTD down to 91.7 %
avoid: faster payment as a gift (no distress shown)
changing terms after its final offer
tactics: Open deep: it gave way fully in past renewals and we have 70180 at 75 %.
Offer more quota from 70180 as binding volume for its new line in exchange for price.
Cite the red Q3 scorecard (5682 ppm) as a separate argument.
Mention its reference status: a competitive price keeps it on our panel.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; past renewals settled below even its own offers (kept share -0.16), so expect it to move readily.
